part.text:
Implemented incremental builds and caching for the SSG.

**New files**
- `src/cache.ts` — `.ssg-cache.json` manifest (version 1) with `hashString`/`hashFile`/`hashDir` (MD5), `loadCache`/`saveCache` (corrupt/incompatible manifests treated as missing), `cachePathFor`, `isEntryValid`.

**Modified**
- `src/types.ts` — `BuildOptions.incremental`/`.clean`, `BuildStats`, `Page.renderMs`.
- `src/engine.ts` — `buildOnce` now: computes per-file source hashes + global template hash; skips the plugin pipeline for pages whose source **and** template hashes are unchanged (reusing cached parsed frontmatter + rendered HTML); removes stale HTML/cache entries for deleted pages; persists the manifest after render; exposes `lastStats`. Clean build when cache missing or `--clean`.
- `plugins/template.ts` — skips wiping `outputDir` and skips re-render for pages that already have cached `rendered` HTML.
- `src/ssg.ts` — added `buildIncremental()` returning `{ pages, stats }`; `build()` unchanged.
- `src/cli.ts` — `--incremental`/`--clean` flags; prints stats (`N built, M skipped (Tms saved)`).
- `__tests__/incremental.test.ts` — 20 tests covering cache helpers, first/second builds, per-page invalidation, template invalidation, frontmatter/HTML caching, deleted/new pages, time-saved reporting, clean/cold builds, plugin compatibility, and CLI flag parsing.

Verified end-to-end via the compiled CLI and `npm run build`. All existing functionality (37 tests) still passes.
